full_text:
Article 4 (Operation of Councils)
(1) Relevant local governments shall actively operate councils so that all issues are handled reasonably and smoothly.
(2) In order to facilitate the operation of Capital Area Councils and Metropolitan Area Councils, the relevant local governments shall each assign dedicated personnel.
